states.name: Nuclear genomic DNA in permeabilized nuclei
Tagmented fragment with s5 adapters at both ends (not amplifiable)
properties: dead end: identical arms cannot be exponentially amplified by the P5/P7 index primer pair

states.name: Tagmented fragment with s7 adapters at both ends (not amplifiable)
properties: dead end: identical arms cannot be exponentially amplified by the P5/P7 index primer pair

states.name: Tagmented fragment with s5 and s7 adapters (amplifiable)
properties: distinct s5 and s7 arms allow exponential amplification
non-transferred mosaic-end strands are not ligated

states.name: Final sci-ATAC-seq sequencing library
properties: cell identity = Tn5 barcode pair plus i5/i7 index pair

transitions.operation_detail: Anneal the barcoded Tn5 transferred-strand oligos s5 and s7 to the 5'-phosphorylated 19-bp mosaic-end non-transferred strand and load onto Tn5 to assemble well-specific barcoded transposomes

Distribute permeabilized nuclei into 96 wells, each with a unique barcode combination, and tagment with 2.5 uM barcoded Tn5 transposome for 30 min at 37 C; stop with 40 mM EDTA. Insertion of s5- and s7-loaded transposomes yields three end combinations; only the s5/s7 fragment is carried forward as amplifiable

Pool all wells, sort 15-25 nuclei into each well of a new 96-well plate, release Tn5 and lyse; gap fill-in and 20 cycles of PCR with indexed P5 and P7 primers annealing to the s5 and s7 arms add the i5 and i7 library indices and the Illumina P5/P7 flow-cell sequences; products are pooled and column-cleaned
